summary: Last night's branch was blocked by the merge workflow (Playwright can't install on Ubuntu 26.04), not by its code; raised it for the owner. Fixed two generator bugs in today's story and fact checks.
why: The hedge check counted "can't" as a hedge and could fail confident scripts; a malformed fact link crashed number-check. Both have tests that fail without the fix. The data audit is 26 h old, so the data check was skipped.

findings.title: Agent merge can't install Playwright on ubuntu-latest (26.04)
findings.detail: Blocks every branch that touches apps/dashboard (auditor and dashboard on 2 Nov). Fix: runs-on: ubuntu-24.04 in agent-merge.yml.

findings.title: The auditor routine fired twice tonight
findings.detail: Second run at 17:56 UTC found nothing new (same code, data audit still from 1 Nov) and only added a note to the report.

changes.title: Malformed maths fact links are notes, not crashes
